name: Weather Classification
description: On-device scene weather classification: a MobileNetV3-Small model classifies the camera view into clear / cloudy / foggy / rainy / snowy with per-class confidence scores. Publishes results over MQTT and streams H.264 via RTSP.
description_zh: 端侧场景天气分类：MobileNetV3-Small 模型将摄像头画面分类为晴天/多云/雾天/雨天/雪天，并输出各类别置信度。通过 MQTT 发布结果，并以 RTSP 推送 H.264 视频。
author: Seeed Studio
